kata.title: Gekisai Dai Ni

kata.origin: Oprindelse: Skabt af Chojun Miyagi i 1940
kata.purpose: Formål: At bygge videre på grundlæggende teknikker

name: Gekisai Dai Ni
description: The second kata in the Gekisai series, building upon the foundation established by Gekisai Dai Ichi.

origin.title: Origin
origin.content: Developed alongside Gekisai Dai Ichi by Chōjun Miyagi and Shoshin Nagamine around 1940.

transmission.title: Transmission to Goju-Ryu
transmission.content: This kata was passed down through the Goju-Ryu lineage.

technicalFeatures.content: The second kata in the Gekisai series, building upon the foundation established by Gekisai Dai Ichi.

controversy.title: Controversy/Variations within Goju-Ryu
controversy.content: There are minor variations in timing and emphasis between different Goju-Ryu schools.
